request.description: Internal endpoint invoked by the workflow scheduler (GCP Cloud Scheduler in production, the docker-scheduler in dev) on each cron tick. Publishes a workflow execute event with trigger_source=scheduled. Not intended for external callers.

item.name: Run a read-only Cypher query and return the first 50 rows

request.description:
Synchronous preview for the Query Workflows UI. Validates the query
(same validator as scheduled runs), runs it against the caller's org
graph with a 10-second timeout and a hard 50-row cap. Read-only —
write keywords are rejected. Not intended for batch use; use the
scheduled-execute path for production reads.
